title: V5 fix: block timing — nonblocking deferred merge (no lock wait)
brief: Owner: with PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_ENABLED both CY nodes exhibit near-deadlock — seal/peer hot paths call block_timing::with_lock which spins up to 30s (20ms sleep) on fs2 exclusive lock. Fix: zero blocking on note_*; per-process in-memory deferred queue keyed by height:round (anchor t0_ms); single try_lock_exclusive per fast cycle (seal loop iteration / optional flush hook) to merge queue→pending.json and append jsonl on seal. If lock busy: drop disk write this cycle, keep queue — never sleep, never block proposer/attester.

issues: LOCK_RETRY_MS=20 + lock_wait_ms=30000 → synchronous stall on seal loop and every cluster wire hook
proposer+attester contend on same .lock → mutual delay looks like cluster freeze
note_* ignores lock timeout silently → missing rows AND lost throughput

principles: Hot path note_*: O(1) push to process-local queue only — never open lock file
Disk: at most one try_lock per seal-loop poll tick (or end of iteration) — WouldBlock → return immediately
Seal finalize: queue SealOp; flush attempts until row written or process exit (do not lose sealed row silently)

queue.scope: Arc<Mutex<DeferredQueue>> on App (per process — proposer and attester separate queues)
queue.key: height:round string; PendRec carries t0_ms as canonical sort/merge key once set
queue.ops: enum: T0, Send, AttRx, AttProc, AttWire, AttOk, GateOk, SealFinalize
queue.merge: apply ops in enqueue order into PendRec fields (same semantics as today)

entry_points: lifecycle seal loop: end of each iteration (after poll sleep branch) — try_flush_once
note_seal: push SealFinalize then try_flush_once (mandatory path)
steps_under_lock: for each SealFinalize in batch: append jsonl line, remove pending key
flush.on_lock_busy: leave queue intact; optional trace counter lock_busy_skipped++

config.cy_cluster: re-enable PWM_BLOCK_TIMING_ENABLED=true in cy-cluster-common.ps1 after fix verified

acceptance_criteria: CY proposer+attester with timing enabled: steady seal continues (head advances, no 20ms+ stalls attributable to block_timing)
tmp/cy-lab-block-timing.jsonl still receives rows after soak (may lag 1–2 blocks under contention — acceptable)
Unit test: two threads — holder keeps lock, note_* returns immediately, queue depth increases; after unlock flush merges
Unit test: no sleep/mock clock — verify try_lock path never blocks >1ms in test harness
Remove DEF_LOCK_WAIT_MS blocking loop from with_lock (function renamed try_flush_disk or similar)
related_tickets: 20260610-v5-cy-sync-ready-attester-preflight-coding — proposer must not treat lagging attester as live for preflight; reduces bogus timing rows while catch-up stalled
